nodes.Loops.name: Loops
nodes.Loops.description: The while loop runs your code again and again. No more pressing ▶ every time.
nodes.Hats.name: Hats
nodes.Hats.description: Colorful hats for your drone, and the wearHat() command.
nodes.Speed.name: Speed
nodes.Speed.description: Each level makes the drone and the code faster. The last two levels also cost fish.
nodes.Grass.name: Wheat
nodes.Grass.description: Each level doubles your wheat harvest.
nodes.Expand.name: Big farm
nodes.Expand.description: Your farm gets bigger. The first level unlocks the go() command.
nodes.Plant.name: Planting
nodes.Plant.description: The sow() command, rosehips, if / else conditions, isRipe() and whatsHere().
nodes.Carrots.name: Eggplant
nodes.Carrots.description: The plow() command and eggplants. Eggplants grow from seeds, and every harvest gives seeds back. The next levels double the harvest.
nodes.Debug.name: Say
nodes.Debug.description: The say() command, to write text and numbers in the console.
nodes.Operators.name: Operators
nodes.Watering.name: Watering
nodes.Watering.description: Water and use(). In wet soil, plants grow up to 5 times faster.
nodes.Trees.name: Apricot trees
nodes.Trees.description: An apricot tree gives a harvest three times, then it gets old and you plant a new one. scan() tells you how many harvests are left. Levels double the wood harvest.
nodes.Mulberry.name: Mulberry tree
nodes.Mulberry.description: The mulberry tree gives wood. If there's a ripe rosehip right next to it when you gather, the bees double the harvest.
nodes.Fertilizer.name: Humus
nodes.Fertilizer.description: Growing the same plant over and over tires the soil out, and the harvest gets smaller. Switch plants or give the soil humus: use(Goods.Humus). Humus also makes plants grow faster.
nodes.Mushrooms.name: Mushrooms
nodes.Mushrooms.description: Mushrooms give magic dust, but they hide to the right or left and learn your habits. Only Math.random() can beat them. The next levels double the harvest.
nodes.Sunflowers.name: Pomegranates
nodes.Sunflowers.description: scan() counts a pomegranate's seeds. Pomegranates with an even number of seeds give juice, and gathering them in rising order gives more and more. drink() makes the drone faster.
nodes.Fishing.name: Fishing
nodes.Fishing.description: Dig a pond with dig(), fill it with water and fish with goFishing(). After a catch the pond rests a little, so lots of ponds give lots of fish. Each new level doubles the fish you catch.
nodes.Mazes.name: Garden maze
nodes.Mazes.description: Plant a maze with magic dust from mushrooms: sow(Plants.Maze). There's treasure inside. Plus the canGo() command.
nodes.Megafarm.name: Drone team
nodes.Megafarm.description: Several drones at once: newDrone(), wait() and more.
nodes.GoldenHat.name: Golden hat
nodes.GoldenHat.description: A shiny golden hat for your drone.
nodes.Pumpkins.name: Watermelons
nodes.Pumpkins.description: scan() measures a watermelon's sweetness, from 0 to 100. Gather it once it reaches 80, but don't be late, or it rots! Levels double the harvest of all watermelons.
nodes.YellowMelon.name: Yellow watermelon
nodes.YellowMelon.description: A ripe yellow watermelon sends tendrils to the empty soil next to it, and a new one grows there. One gather() picks up all the ripe ones that touch: n of them give n × n.
nodes.SquareMelon.name: Square watermelon
nodes.SquareMelon.description: Ripe square watermelons side by side join into one giant. An n × n square gives n × n × n.
nodes.Cactus.name: Grapevines
nodes.Cactus.description: Grapevines, exchange() and scan(). Sort a row from left to right, sour to sweet, and n grapes give n × n.
nodes.Dinosaurs.name: Snake
nodes.Dinosaurs.description: The snake hat. Your drone turns into a snake and hunts a runaway mouse. Every mouse makes the snake's tail longer, and at the end the snake gives snake skin.
nodes.Secret.name: Secret
nodes.Secret.description: What's in here… Only the most determined farmers will find out.
nodes.SetSpeed.name: Slow motion
nodes.SetSpeed.description: speed() slows your drone down, so you can calmly watch what your code does.
nodes.Timing.name: Clock
nodes.Timing.description: time() and steps(): measure how long your code takes.
nodes.Debugger.name: Variables window
nodes.Debugger.description: See the values of all your variables while your code runs.
nodes.Final.name: Golden farm
nodes.Final.description: The last research. You become a real coder-farmer.
nodes.Senses.name: Senses
nodes.Senses.description: posX(), posY(), farmSize() and count(). The drone knows where it is and what it has.
nodes.Calendar.name: Calendar
nodes.Calendar.description: season(), weather() and nextWeather(). Your code knows the season and the weather, so it can do one thing in winter and another in summer.
nodes.Variables.name: Variables
nodes.Variables.description: let, const and =. Keep numbers and values in variables.
nodes.Lists.name: Lists
nodes.Lists.description: Arrays (lists), the for…of loop, push() and length.
nodes.Objects.name: Objects
nodes.Objects.description: Objects, Map and Set, to keep values by name.
nodes.Music.name: Music
nodes.Music.description: The drone plays music: playNote(Notes.C, 1). A list of notes and a loop make a song. Just for fun.
nodes.Costs.name: Prices
nodes.Costs.description: costOf() and level(): find out research prices and levels from your code.
nodes.AutoUnlock.name: Auto research
nodes.AutoUnlock.description: The research() command: buy research right from your code.
nodes.Ranch.name: Ranch
nodes.Ranch.description: Behind the village there's an old ranch with animals. There, each area has its own drone and its own code, and eggs and milk sell for ֏ (dram, Armenian money).
nodes.Market.name: Market
nodes.Market.description: Trade goods with real players. Post an order, and others will see it and take it. The price has to be fair, and there are no gifts.
nodes.Functions.name: Functions
nodes.Functions.description: Write your own functions: function and return.
nodes.Import.name: Import
nodes.Import.description: import and export: use the functions of one file in another file.
nodes.Utilities.name: Math and random numbers
nodes.Utilities.description: The Math object: Math.random(), Math.floor(), Math.max() and other handy functions.
